name: Ace Marks the Spot
summary: A relaxing card-based monster-hunting game that combines +1/-1 solitaire-style gameplay with crafting and exploration. Build card combos to defeat beasts, gather materials and doubloons, craft and upgrade more than 50 unique weapons, and travel across five islands as you take on increasingly powerful monsters. With a slow-burn progression system and no game-overs, the focus is on strategy, efficiency, and steadily growing your power.
